name: 14605 · Rochester, NY
findings: ZIP 14605 (Rochester) has 72 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14605 (Rochester) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 14605 (Rochester) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 18% of all organizations here have no identified type.
